liability.rule: Supplier liability must be capped at no less than 12 months of fees. Uncapped liability for the customer is not acceptable.

data_location.rule: All customer data, including backups, must be stored and processed in Australia. Any offshore processing needs written approval from our Chief Risk Officer.

payment_terms.rule: We pay invoices within 30 days of receipt. Longer terms are fine. Shorter terms need Finance approval.

termination_for_convenience.rule: We must be able to terminate for convenience on no more than 90 days' notice.

auto_renewal.rule: Automatic renewal is acceptable only if the supplier must remind us at least 60 days before the renewal date.

governing_law.rule: The contract must be governed by the laws of Victoria or New South Wales.

intellectual_property.rule: We must own all deliverables created specifically for us. The supplier keeps its pre-existing tools.

confidentiality.rule: Confidentiality obligations must survive termination for at least three years.
